reforms.description: The government proposed legislation to establish a National Economic Development Board to encourage economic growth and strengthen the balance of payments.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The establishment of a National Economic Development Board is aimed at fostering economic growth, which is inherently supportive of productivity and innovation.
reforms.importance_rationale: The proposal represents a significant structural change in the governance of economic development.
reforms.source_quote: Legislation establishing a National Economic Development Board would be proposed.

reforms.description: The government plans to reintroduce various tax incentives to stimulate production and industrial research.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Reintroducing tax incentives is expected to stimulate industrial research and production, thereby enhancing innovation and economic activity.
reforms.status_evidence: The government plans to reintroduce various tax incentives.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, the reintroduction of tax incentives is a narrower reform compared to the establishment of a national board.
reforms.source_quote: Various tax incentives to stimulate production and industrial research would be re-introduced.
